strings.startup_greeting: Il sistema di correzione della postura yoga si avvia.
strings.cmd_what_pose_unknown: Non ho ancora identificato la posizione — dammi un momento.
strings.cmd_pause: Correzioni in pausa. Di' riprendi quando sei pronto.
strings.cmd_help: Puoi dire: punteggio, quale postura, passo successivo, ripeti, pausa, riprendi o ricomincia.
strings.cam_too_close: Sei troppo vicino! Per favore fai un passo indietro per far entrare tutto il corpo nel campo visivo.
strings.cam_too_far: Sei un po' lontano. Per favore avvicinati alla fotocamera.
strings.cam_sideways: Sembra che tu stia di lato. Per favore guarda direttamente la fotocamera.
strings.cam_low_visibility: Alcune parti del corpo non sono visibili — controlla l'illuminazione.
strings.event_hold_achieved: Eccellente! Hai mantenuto {pose_name} con successo. Continua a respirare e rimani nella postura.
strings.event_catching_up: Molto bene! Ora recuperiamo — l'istruttore è in {new_pose}. Ti guiderò.
strings.event_frozen: L'istruttore è andato avanti, ma va bene — concentriamoci prima su {pose_name}. Porta il punteggio sopra {threshold} per cento e mantieni {hold_sec} secondi.
strings.score_excellent_3: Più di novanta — il tuo corpo è esattamente dove deve essere.
strings.score_good_1: Sei all'{score} per cento — buon allineamento, piccoli aggiustamenti rimasti.
strings.score_good_3: Bene all'{score} — solo un po' da rifinire.
strings.score_fair_2: All'{score}% — continua a lavorare sulle correzioni.
strings.score_fair_3: {score}%. Mantieni la concentrazione e continua a respirare.
strings.score_needs_work_2: Sei all'{score}%. Nessuna fretta — continua ad aggiustare.
strings.well_done_2: Sì! Quella è la forma. Rimani con essa.
strings.enc_medium_1: Stai andando bene — continua ad aggiustare.
strings.enc_large_1: Prenditi il tuo tempo — questo viene con la pratica.
strings.enc_large_3: Ogni corpo è diverso — fai quello che puoi.
strings.summary_no_attempts: La tua sessione è completa. Non ho registrato tentativi di postura completi questa volta. Ottimo sforzo comunque!
strings.summary_opening_with_time: Ottima sessione! Hai praticato per circa {minutes} {minute_word}.
strings.summary_all_held: Hai mantenuto con successo ogni postura — {names}. Fantastico risultato!
strings.summary_some_held: Hai mantenuto con successo {held} su {total} posture: {names}.
strings.summary_missed_singular: La postura su cui continuare a lavorare è {names}. Il tuo miglior punteggio è stato: {scores}. Ce la farai con un po' più di pratica!
strings.summary_missed_plural: Le posture su cui continuare a lavorare sono {names}. I tuoi migliori punteggi sono stati: {scores}.
strings.summary_closer_1: Ricorda, ogni pratica conta — ci vediamo presto sul tappetino!
strings.summary_closer_2: La costanza è la chiave del progresso. Continua a venire!
strings.summary_closer_3: Ogni sessione ti rende più forte. Ottimo oggi!
strings.summary_closer_4: Prenditi un momento per respirare e celebrare il tuo sforzo oggi.
strings.cam_cant_see: Non riesco a vederti. Mettiti davanti alla fotocamera in un'area ben illuminata.
strings.cam_parts_missing: Alcune parti del tuo corpo non sono visibili. Fai un passo indietro.
strings.hold_grace_period: L'istruttore è andato avanti, ma non preoccuparti — prenditi il tempo per entrare in {pose_name}. Hai ancora circa {breaths} cicli respiratori.
strings.hold_release: Nessun problema — seguiamo l'istruttore. Praticheremo {pose_name} la prossima volta.

strings.step_mountain_0: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
strings.step_mountain_1: Press all four corners of your feet firmly into the ground.
strings.step_mountain_2: Engage your thighs and lift your kneecaps slightly.
strings.step_mountain_3: Lengthen your tailbone down and lift your chest.
strings.step_mountain_4: Relax your shoulders away from your ears, arms at your sides.
strings.step_mountain_5: Breathe steadily and hold for five to ten breaths.
strings.step_forward_fold_2: Exhale and hinge forward from your hips.
strings.step_forward_fold_3: Let your hands hang toward the floor or hold your elbows.
strings.step_forward_fold_4: Bend your knees generously if your hamstrings are tight.
strings.step_forward_fold_5: Relax your head and neck completely.
strings.step_forward_fold_6: Hold for five breaths, deepening with each exhale.
strings.step_halfway_lift_0: From Forward Fold, place your hands on your shins.
strings.step_halfway_lift_1: Inhale and lift your chest halfway up.
strings.step_halfway_lift_2: Make your back as flat as a tabletop.
strings.step_halfway_lift_3: Draw your shoulder blades together and down.
strings.step_halfway_lift_4: Keep your neck in line with your spine.
strings.step_halfway_lift_5: Hold for one breath before moving on.
strings.step_warrior_i_0: Step your left foot back about three to four feet.
strings.step_warrior_i_1: Turn your left foot out to about forty-five degrees.
strings.step_warrior_i_2: Bend your right knee directly over your right ankle.
strings.step_warrior_i_3: Square your hips to face the front of your mat.
strings.step_warrior_i_4: Inhale and raise both arms straight overhead.
strings.step_warrior_i_5: Draw your shoulder blades down your back.
strings.step_warrior_i_6: Gaze forward or slightly upward and hold for five breaths.
strings.step_warrior_ii_0: Step your feet wide apart, about four feet.
strings.step_warrior_ii_1: Turn your right foot out ninety degrees, left foot in slightly.
strings.step_warrior_ii_2: Bend your right knee to ninety degrees over your ankle.
strings.step_warrior_ii_3: Extend both arms out to the sides at shoulder height — palms down.
strings.step_warrior_ii_4: Keep your torso directly over your hips, not leaning forward.
strings.step_warrior_ii_5: Turn your head to gaze over your right fingertips.
strings.step_warrior_ii_6: Hold for five steady breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_warrior_iii_0: Begin standing on your right foot.
strings.step_warrior_iii_1: Hinge forward at your hip, lifting your left leg behind you.
strings.step_warrior_iii_2: Reach your torso and left leg parallel to the floor.
strings.step_warrior_iii_3: Extend your arms forward or keep them by your sides.
strings.step_warrior_iii_4: Flex your raised foot and keep your hips level.
strings.step_warrior_iii_5: Hold for three to five breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_chair_1: Inhale and raise your arms straight overhead.
strings.step_chair_2: Exhale and bend your knees, lowering your hips as if sitting.
strings.step_chair_3: Bring your thighs as parallel to the floor as comfortable.
strings.step_chair_4: Keep your knees over your toes.
strings.step_chair_5: Draw your lower belly in and lengthen your spine.
strings.step_tree_0: Shift your weight onto your left foot.
strings.step_tree_1: Bend your right knee and place your right foot on your inner left thigh.
strings.step_tree_2: Press foot and thigh against each other for stability.
strings.step_tree_3: Bring your palms together at your chest or raise arms overhead.
strings.step_tree_4: Fix your gaze on a steady point in front of you.
strings.step_tree_5: Hold for five breaths, then repeat on the other side.
strings.step_triangle_0: Step your feet wide apart, about three to four feet.
strings.step_triangle_1: Turn your right foot out ninety degrees.
strings.step_triangle_2: Extend both arms out to the sides.
strings.step_triangle_3: Reach your right hand toward your right shin.
strings.step_triangle_4: Stack your left arm directly above your right.
strings.step_triangle_5: Keep both legs straight and your torso long.
strings.step_triangle_6: Gaze up toward your raised hand. Hold five breaths.
strings.step_downward_dog_1: Tuck your toes and press your hips up and back.
strings.step_downward_dog_2: Straighten your legs as much as comfortable.
strings.step_downward_dog_3: Press your hands firmly into the mat, fingers spread wide.
strings.step_downward_dog_4: Let your head hang between your upper arms.
strings.step_downward_dog_5: Draw your navel toward your spine.
strings.step_downward_dog_6: Hold for five to ten breaths.
strings.step_plank_0: Begin on your hands and knees.
strings.step_plank_1: Step both feet back so your body forms a straight line.
strings.step_plank_2: Stack your wrists directly under your shoulders.
strings.step_plank_3: Engage your core — draw your belly button toward your spine.
strings.step_plank_4: Keep your hips level — not sagging or piking up.
strings.step_plank_5: Press through your heels and gaze slightly forward.
strings.step_low_lunge_0: Step your right foot forward between your hands.
strings.step_low_lunge_1: Lower your left knee to the mat.
strings.step_low_lunge_2: Sink your hips forward and down.
strings.step_low_lunge_3: Inhale and raise your arms overhead.
strings.step_low_lunge_4: Draw your shoulder blades down and open your chest.
strings.step_low_lunge_5: Hold for five breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_high_lunge_0: Step your right foot forward, keeping the back leg straight.
strings.step_high_lunge_1: Bend your right knee to ninety degrees.
strings.step_high_lunge_3: Inhale and raise both arms overhead.
strings.step_high_lunge_4: Square your hips forward as much as possible.
strings.step_high_lunge_5: Hold for five breaths, then switch sides.
strings.step_cobra_0: Lie face down with legs extended behind you.
strings.step_cobra_1: Place your palms flat under your shoulders.
strings.step_cobra_2: Press the tops of your feet into the mat.
strings.step_cobra_3: Inhale and slowly lift your chest.
strings.step_cobra_4: Keep your elbows slightly bent and close to your sides.
strings.step_cobra_5: Roll your shoulders back and open your chest.
strings.step_cobra_6: Hold for five breaths, then slowly lower down.
strings.step_upward_dog_0: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
strings.step_upward_dog_1: Press firmly into your hands and straighten your arms.
strings.step_upward_dog_2: Lift your thighs and knees off the mat.
strings.step_upward_dog_3: Roll your shoulders back and lift your chest high.
strings.step_upward_dog_4: Press the tops of your feet into the mat.
strings.step_upward_dog_5: Hold for one to three breaths.
strings.step_child_0: Kneel on the mat with your big toes touching.
strings.step_child_1: Sit back on your heels and open your knees hip-width apart.
strings.step_child_2: Exhale and fold your torso forward between your thighs.
strings.step_child_3: Extend your arms forward on the mat, palms facing down.
strings.step_child_4: Rest your forehead gently on the mat.
strings.step_child_6: Rest here for five to ten breaths.
strings.step_seated_forward_0: Sit with both legs extended straight in front of you.
strings.step_seated_forward_1: Flex your feet, pressing through your heels.
strings.step_seated_forward_2: Inhale and lengthen your spine, raising arms overhead.
strings.step_seated_forward_3: Exhale and hinge forward from your hips.
strings.step_seated_forward_4: Reach toward your shins, ankles, or feet.
strings.step_seated_forward_5: Keep your spine long rather than rounding your back.
strings.step_seated_forward_6: Hold for five to eight breaths.
strings.step_cat_cow_0: Come onto your hands and knees — wrists under shoulders, knees under hips.
strings.step_cat_cow_1: For Cow: inhale, drop your belly, lift your chest and tailbone.
strings.step_cat_cow_2: For Cat: exhale, round your spine up toward the ceiling.
strings.step_cat_cow_3: Tuck your chin to your chest and your tailbone under.
strings.step_cat_cow_4: Move slowly, linking each movement to your breath.
strings.step_cat_cow_5: Continue for five to ten cycles.
